name: origin-physical-ai
description: Origin Physical AI — the robot-readiness + agent-autonomy + RL-environment monorepo (Console, Janus, Cobra, Chronos, Factory).
comment:workspaces: chronos-ui is React 18 and is installed STANDALONE (its own node_modules) so its types don't collide with the React 19 apps under npm hoisting. The Makefile builds it separately. Switch to pnpm later for true isolation (see docs/MIGRATION.md).

scripts.build:chronos-ui: npm --prefix apps/chronos-ui install && npm --prefix apps/chronos-ui run build

comment:overrides: @insforge/shared-schemas (via @insforge/sdk) still declares zod ^3, and every zod below 4.6.6 carries GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (no v3 patch). The SDK reads only ERROR_CODES and oAuthProvidersSchema.options from it and parses nothing with zod; both values are identical under zod 4. Its .d.ts files are written for zod 3, so its types resolve to any under zod 4 (skipLibCheck hides this): in Origin that loosens only the signUp and signInWithPassword calls in apps/origin-web/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx. Drop this override once @insforge/shared-schemas depends on zod >=4.6.6.
